name: DevAgent Production Qualification v5 - Autonomy
qualification_rule: The complete v4 catalog and every v5 autonomy case must pass before v0.8 may merge.

cases.expected: parallel execution never exceeds configured capacity and result order is deterministic
parallel autonomy fails closed before spawning when real source changes exist
two DevAgent runs are VERIFIED in distinct isolated worktrees while source remains unchanged
only bounded relevant repository skills are selected and oversized skill files are rejected before unbounded reads
matched repository skill context is injected without changing provider authority
overlapping schedulers atomically claim due work once, expired claims recover, and stale outcomes cannot overwrite newer claims
equivalent provider/model/base-url targets are benchmarked once
strict live structured provider contract is executed and measured
benchmark reports redact the configured credential regardless of env-name casing and also redact heuristic secret env values
